results.name: Master v1.0 component API exposes default toolbar order and optional tabs without empty space
Configuration creates independent table roots/data/default widths/order/pins/hidden columns
Default tool order/fixed search/header groups/feature flags reuse core DOM controls
Selection business actions receive only own rows, never range selection or legacy data
Search/filter/table configuration remain independent across root documents
Optional Header Slot uses same header DOM, retains 56px height and supports removal
Destroy cleans up composed group/selection observers, iframe roots and page DOM
New module and two pages are defined by configuration; route/sidebar/data/state remain independent
